title: Morocco in October – Weather, Crowds & What to Pack
description: October is one of the best months to visit Morocco. Get local advice on weather, festivals, packing, and the best places to go.
content:
## Weather

October brings mild, sunny days (22-28°C) and cool evenings. Perfect for exploring cities and the desert.

## Crowds

Summer crowds have left, but it's not yet peak season. A sweet spot for a relaxed trip.

## Where to Go

- Chefchaouen: crisp mountain air, clear skies
- Sahara: comfortable days, cold but magical nights
- Marrakech: warm enough for pools, cool enough for sightseeing

## What to Pack

- Layers for warm days and cool nights
- Light jacket or sweater
- Comfortable walking shoes
